The Shop

An inspection station and repair shop where the work gets explained — and you never get sold parts you don't need.

Marty's Auto Service LLC is run by Marty, an ASE certified Master Mechanic with over 20 years of experience working on all makes and models.

The shop emphasizes honest, explained work: what was done to your vehicle, and why, in terms that make sense — so you always know what you're paying for.

Walk-ins are welcome for inspections and maintenance, and every job — from a state inspection to an engine replacement — gets the same straight answer.
